verdict: ROAS recovered strongly; purchase volume and local visibility need attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $5,532.92 in revenue on $1,485.04 in spend — a 3.73 return on ad spend — with 34 purchases completed. The week-over-week efficiency jump of 75% is real, but it came from fewer, higher-value orders rather than more customers buying, and the last few days have shown very little purchase activity while daily spend held steady. Separately, your Google Business Profile went quiet on October 1st, dropping local engagement sharply, and we are investigating the cause now. Several planned deliverables — including email flows, subscribe pages, and UTM tracking — are overdue and being prioritised this period; getting those live will give us a much clearer picture of what is driving conversions and unlock the next phase of growth.
